correctness.rationale: For X²=T with T of Jordan type (2^n,1^n), the squaring map on Jordan blocks forces precisely X type (4^r,3^{n-2r},2^s,1^{2(r-s)}) with 0<=s<=r<=floor(n/2). Because any conjugator between roots preserves their squares, roots of one type form exactly one orbit under the units of End_{F_q[t]}(M_n). Its orbit size is |C_GL(T)|/|C_GL(X)| with centralizer unit order q^{sum_j(column length_j)²} prod_d D_{c_d}(q), giving the stated H_{n,r,s}. Ranks follow from block counts. With u=n/2-r, d=r-s, the exponent becomes 5n²/2-2u²-2d²; denominators for the two large multiplicities tend to D_infinity, uniformly on u+d<=n/4, while the complementary Gaussian tail is superpolynomially small. Hence fixed-q, parity-specific total variation product limit with O_q(q^{-n/4}) and root-count asymptotic. Independent exact rational checks verified integer orbit-size counts n=1..4, q=2,3 and n=2,q=2 stratum 96+192+576=864. Finite computations do not prove the limit.

The independent asymptotic Gaussian-product laws for two intrinsic rank defects are not a renaming of existence conditions, centralizer orders, or a tiny table; the rank-and-cubic-rank statistics and quantitative convergence add structural information.
